sourceUnits.zh: 石季龍掠騎至曆陽，導請出討之。
sourceUnits.en: Shi Jilong's raiding horsemen reached Liyang; Dao requested to go out and campaign against them.

sourceUnits.zh: 加大司馬、假黃鉞、中外諸軍事，置左右長史、司馬，給布萬匹。
sourceUnits.en: He was added Grand Marshal, lent yellow axe, command of military affairs within and without; left and right senior clerks and majors were established; ten thousand bolts of cloth supplied.

sourceUnits.zh: 俄而賊退，解大司馬，復轉中外大都督，進位太傅，又拜丞相，依漢制罷司徒官以並之。
sourceUnits.en: Soon the bandits withdrew; he was relieved of Grand Marshal, again transferred to grand commander of all within and without, advanced to Grand Tutor, also appointed Chancellor, and following Han system the Minister of Education post was abolished to merge with it.
